meta.description: A volunteer-run Islamic outreach and community service association in Trinidad and Tobago. Street dawah, free community markets, soup kitchens and home rebuilds for families in need.

about.heading: The on-the-ground voice of Islamic outreach in the Caribbean.
about.statement: We meet people where they are, in the street and online, with patience, knowledge and genuine care.
paragraphs: The Caribbean Dawah Association (CDA) is a group of everyday Muslims in Trinidad and Tobago who give their evenings and weekends to two things: answering honest questions about Islam, and looking after people who need a hand.

You will find us behind a Discover Islam table on a busy street, handing out free Qurans at a community market, serving hot meals at the soup kitchen, or helping a single mother get a safe roof over her children. Every question deserves a real answer, not a lecture. Every family deserves to be treated with dignity.
about.imageAlt: CDA's Discover Islam booth on the street with free books and Qurans laid out for passers-by

programs.title: Street dawah
programs.text: Our Discover Islam booths set up on busy streets like Marabella's. Free books, free Qurans and a friendly face for anyone who is curious.

programs.title: Ask Us Anything
programs.text: A weekly series answering the questions people actually ask about Islam, simply and honestly. Got one you have always wanted to ask? Send it in.

programs.title: Classes and workshops
programs.text: Arabic courses, Quran exhibitions and dawah workshops that help our community learn, and train new volunteers to share with confidence.

programs.title: Soup kitchens
programs.text: Hot meals served at our soup kitchens in north and south Trinidad. More than 20,000 plates a year, given freely to anyone who comes.

programs.title: Free community markets
programs.text: Fresh produce, dry goods and Qurans, 100% free, hosted with local masjids. One market in Sangre Grande welcomed almost 300 families.

programs.title: Home rebuilds
programs.text: Through our Muslim Housing Committee, Zakat is turned into safe, solid homes for families living in unsafe conditions, many of them single mothers.

story.heading: Transforming a life, step by step.
story.text: Many of the families we meet live in homes with rotting boards, open doorways and nowhere safe for children to sleep. Through our Muslim Housing Committee, your Zakat and Sadaqah become homes with solid block walls, a sound roof and a door that locks. Right now we are walking alongside a single mother of six whose home was in critical condition when we first visited.
story.beforeAlt: A damaged wooden house on stilts with broken walls and an open doorway, surrounded by overgrown grass
story.afterAlt: A finished Muslim Housing Committee home: new concrete block walls, a galvanised roof, a glass window and a solid front door

reflection.text: The best of people are those who benefit others.

donate.heading: Your gift, straight to the work.
donate.intro: We are a small, fully volunteer team, so your donation goes to meals, markets, Qurans and homes. Right now we accept bank transfers, online banking and international wire transfers.
donate.referenceHint: Add a note such as "Soup Kitchen", "Home Rebuild" or "General" so we can put your gift exactly where you intend.
donate.afterText: Once you have sent your transfer, message us a screenshot so we can confirm it and make du'a for you.
donate.internationalText: Giving from abroad? Use the SWIFT code RBTTTTPX with the account details above for an online or international wire transfer.
donate.cardNote: Card payments are coming soon, insha'Allah.

involved.title: Volunteer with us
involved.text: Serve meals, pack hampers, help at a market or join us on the street. No experience needed, just a good heart and a little time.

involved.title: Ask us anything
involved.text: Curious about Islam? Every question deserves a real answer, not a lecture. Send yours in and we will get back to you.

involved.title: Partner with us
involved.text: Masjids, businesses and organisations: host a market, sponsor an event or donate goods. Together we reach further.
